questions.question:
Given below are two statements and two conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion(s) follow(s) the given statements.

**Statements:**

All trains are buses.

Some buses are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. All cars are buses.

II. Some buses are trains.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/956ca89c3caa4712ea0d2f75f20277cf05bfe7463bf1cd4402732ca9d1a75b4b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ec94b694c3c183965df69a6771903a7d3c8b1ddda1219d2939120e826890344.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All cars are buses → **Does not** follow (As some buses are cars. So it is possible but not definite)

II. Some buses are trains → Follow (As all trains are buses. As whole trains comes in buses, therefore some buses are trains is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.solution:

Now,

For, 76 : 69

For, 49 : 45

⇒ (49 - 4) = 45.

Similarly, for **69 : ?**

**⇒ (69 - 6) = 63.**

questions.question: J, K, L, M, O and P are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Both L and M are immediate neighbours of J. Only one person sits between M and P. O sits second to the right of J. O is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who is sitting to the immediate right of K?

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

71+32times 2-63div 7+[(81)⁽¹⁾/⁽⁴⁾]times 3-22=113

Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

23 − 27
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is: **(Reverse of 1st number - Sum of the digits of 1st number) = 2nd number

23 − 27

32 - __**(2 + 3)**__ = 27

__**32 - 5**__ = 27

27 = 27 (LHS = RHS) 

So, checking each option one by one:-

Option 1) 15 − 25

51 - __**(1 + 5)**__ = 25

__**51 - 6**__ = 25

45 ≠ 25 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) 11 − 33

11 - __(1 + 1)__ = 33

__11 - 2__ = 33

9 ≠ 33 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) 15 − 45

51 - __**(1 + 5)**__ = 45

__**51 - 6**__ = 45

**45 = 45 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 4) 11 − 55

11 - __(1 + 1)__ = 55

__11 - 2__ = 55

9 ≠ 55 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '15 − 45' share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

⇒ 17 × 7 - __**148 ÷ 4**__ + 22 = ?

⇒ __**17 × 7**__ - 37 + 22 = ?

⇒ __**119**__ - 37 **__+ 22__** = ?

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pebbles are stones.

No stones are shells.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pebbles are shells.

II. No shells are stones.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1d6db203af6a81349cb11c9ebdd64189eccddc8a68a0df865280b780def1cdc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pebbles are shells → Does not follow (As all pebbles are stones and no stones are shells. As all pebbles comes in stones which cannot be shells therefore all pebbles cannot be shells. Thus, some pebbles are shells is false.)

II. No shells are stones → Follow (As no stones are shells. As whole stones cannot be shells therefore no shells are stones is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

⇒ __**342 ÷ 2**__ + 125 × 1 - 43 = ?

⇒ 171 + __**125 × 1**__ - 43 = ?

⇒ __296** - 43**__ = **253**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
